_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'PROCUREMENT MANAGEMENT PLAN' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.09.01.

f01_Procurement_Strategy_and_Project_Int.label: Procurement Strategy and Project Integration
f01_Procurement_Strategy_and_Project_Int.guidance: Integration strategy coordinating contract acquisitions with overall project schedule and scope baselines.

f02_Procurement_Timetable_and_Milestone_.label: Procurement Timetable and Milestone Alignment
f02_Procurement_Timetable_and_Milestone_.guidance: Key procurement lifecycle milestones (RFP issuance, bid evaluation, contract award, delivery).

f03_Procurement_Roles_and_Sign_off_Autho.label: Procurement Roles and Sign-off Authority
f03_Procurement_Roles_and_Sign_off_Autho.guidance: Defined roles (Procurement Manager, Legal Counsel, Technical Evaluators) and contracting authority limits.

f04_Vendor_Performance_Metrics_and_SLAs.label: Vendor Performance Metrics and SLAs
f04_Vendor_Performance_Metrics_and_SLAs.guidance: Objective metrics and service level agreements used to measure vendor performance.

f05_Standard_Contract_Types_Selection.label: Standard Contract Types Selection
f05_Standard_Contract_Types_Selection.guidance: Authorized contract structures (Firm Fixed Price, Time and Materials, Cost-Plus) mapped to deliverable types.

f06_Pre_Qualified_Vendor_Selection_Appro.label: Pre-Qualified Vendor Selection Approach
f06_Pre_Qualified_Vendor_Selection_Appro.guidance: Approach for evaluating and maintaining pre-qualified vendor lists and source directories.

f07_Legal_Jurisdiction_Dispute_Terms_and.section: Legal Jurisdiction, Currency, and Risk Management
f07_Legal_Jurisdiction_Dispute_Terms_and.label: Legal Jurisdiction, Dispute Terms, and Currency
f07_Legal_Jurisdiction_Dispute_Terms_and.guidance: Governing commercial legal jurisdiction, dispute resolution protocols, and billing currency.

f08_Procurement_Risk_and_Independent_Est.section: Legal Jurisdiction, Currency, and Risk Management
f08_Procurement_Risk_and_Independent_Est.label: Procurement Risk and Independent Estimates
f08_Procurement_Risk_and_Independent_Est.guidance: Independent Cost Estimate (ICE) requirements and vendor default mitigation strategies.
